description: Issue #13 tasks 1, 2 and 3 in the backend: (1) make the generated prediction narrative language-aware (EN/JA) for both the Bedrock prompt and the deterministic fallback; (2) make the Bedrock model SELECTABLE instead of hardcoded to Haiku; (3) offer AMAZON-family models (Amazon Nova) as the selectable choices via a per-provider request/response adapter, because Nova's InvokeModel body/response JSON differs from Anthropic's. Keep the existing Claude path working and keep the deterministic fallback for any model. Thread `language` and `model` through handler -> service -> generateNarrative. NOTE: Amazon Titan has no TEXT-generation model in us-east-1 (only embeddings), so the Amazon-family text options are the Nova family; the exact verified ids are listed in the steps.
steps: Add a shared Lang type usable by the backend. The frontend already defines Lang='ja'|'en' in frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts, but domain/contract types must live in @mlb/shared. Add `export type NarrativeLanguage = 'en' | 'ja';` (and a `DEFAULT_NARRATIVE_LANGUAGE` constant, choose 'en' as the API default so a missing lang is well-defined; document that the frontend always sends its UI language) to a new shared module shared/src/narrative.ts, re-exported from shared/src/index.ts. Keep it dependency-free.

Define the Amazon model allowlist + default in shared/src/narrative.ts so both backend and frontend consume one source of truth (mirrors how accuracy bounds live in @mlb/shared). Provide: an ordered list of selectable model options, each with { id, provider: 'amazon'|'anthropic', labelKey or label }. Verified real ids for us-east-1 (confirmed via aws bedrock list-foundation-models/list-inference-profiles this session): 'us.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0', 'us.amazon.nova-lite-v1:0', 'us.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0' (Amazon Nova, provider amazon) and the existing 'us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0' (provider anthropic, keep available as a non-default option). Choose DEFAULT model = 'us.amazon.nova-lite-v1:0' (Amazon-family per Issue #13 task 3; Nova Lite balances quality/latency/cost and supports on-demand + inference profile). Export a `resolveModelId(id?: string): string` that returns the id if it is in the allowlist else the default (server-side allowlist validation; never throw).

Refactor backend/src/bedrock/narrative.ts to introduce a per-provider adapter. Define an internal strategy keyed by provider that knows how to (a) shape the InvokeModel request body and (b) parse the response text. Anthropic strategy = the current body ({anthropic_version, max_tokens, temperature, messages:[{role:'user',content:[{type:'text',text}]}]}) and content[].text parsing. Amazon Nova strategy = the Bedrock Converse-style messages body for InvokeModel: { messages: [{ role: 'user', content: [{ text: prompt }] }], inferenceConfig: { maxTokens: 300, temperature: 0.5 } } and response parsing from output.message.content[].text (Nova InvokeModel returns { output: { message: { content: [{ text }] } } }). Select the strategy by inspecting the model id (contains 'amazon.' -> amazon/nova; contains 'anthropic.' -> anthropic). Keep DEFAULT_MODEL_ID exported but set it from the shared default; keep backward-compatible exports used by existing tests where practical (the existing narrative.test.ts asserts DEFAULT_MODEL_ID equals the Claude id and asserts the Anthropic body shape - update those assertions deliberately to the new default while adding NEW Nova assertions; do not silently delete coverage).

Make buildPrompt and fallbackNarrative language-aware. Add a `language: NarrativeLanguage` parameter. For 'ja' produce a Japanese analyst prompt instructing a concise 2-3 sentence Japanese narrative; for 'en' keep the English prompt. The deterministic fallbackNarrative must also return Japanese prose for 'ja' and English for 'en', using the same team labels (team club names stay in English per the existing i18n convention in messages.ts, but the surrounding sentence is localized). Keep the numeric percent and team names identical across languages.

Update generateNarrative(series, prediction, invoker, modelId, language) to accept language and the resolved modelId, pass language into buildPrompt and (on error) fallbackNarrative, and keep returning { narrative, model } where model includes ' (fallback)' on the fallback path.

Thread language + model through the service: BracketService.getPrediction(seriesId, season, accuracy, language?, model?) resolves the model via resolveModelId and passes language (defaulting to DEFAULT_NARRATIVE_LANGUAGE) into generateNarrative. Keep the results-only / upcoming / final short-circuits unchanged (no Bedrock call there).

Thread language + model through the handler backend/src/handlers/getPrediction.ts for BOTH GET (query params lang, model) and POST (body fields language/lang, model). Add parseLanguage(value) and parseModelId(value) helpers in backend/src/handlers/http.ts that mirror parseAccuracy: lenient, returning undefined for missing/invalid so the service default applies; NEVER return HTTP 400 for a missing or unknown lang/model. parseLanguage normalizes case and maps only 'en'/'ja' (and tolerates 'en-US'/'ja-JP' prefixes) else undefined. parseModelId returns the raw string (service allowlists it) or undefined.

Update backend/src/bedrock/narrative.test.ts: keep the mocked-invoker success/fallback tests but extend them to assert EN vs JA prompt content and EN vs JA fallback text. Add RealBedrockInvoker request/response shaping tests for the Amazon Nova strategy (inject a stub BedrockRuntimeClient whose send() returns a Nova-shaped body { output: { message: { content: [{ text }] } } } and assert the sent InvokeModelCommand body is the Nova messages/inferenceConfig shape and the parsed text is correct), alongside the existing Anthropic shaping tests. Add tests for resolveModelId (known Amazon id passes through, unknown falls back to default, undefined -> default) and for the allowlist containing the three Nova ids + the Claude id.

Add/adjust backend handler + service tests (backend/src/handlers/getPrediction.test.ts and backend/src/service/bracketService.test.ts) to cover: a GET with &lang=ja&model=us.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0 reaches generateNarrative with ja + the resolved model; a missing lang defaults without 400; an unknown model falls back to the default without 400; results-only/final/upcoming still skip Bedrock.
acceptance_criteria: generateNarrative produces a Japanese prompt + Japanese fallback for language 'ja' and English for 'en', verified by unit tests with a mocked invoker.

RealBedrockInvoker sends an Amazon Nova-shaped InvokeModel body and parses output.message.content[].text for a Nova model id, and still sends the Anthropic body/parses content[].text for a Claude model id - both asserted by injected-client tests with no live AWS call.
resolveModelId allowlists exactly the three verified Nova ids plus the Claude id and falls back to the default for anything else; the default is an Amazon Nova model.
GET/POST /prediction accept optional lang and model, default leniently, and never return 400 for a missing/unknown lang or model.
`npm run build` and `npm test` pass for @mlb/shared and @mlb/backend.
verification: PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build -w @mlb/shared && PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build -w @mlb/backend
findings: Implemented on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site in commit 8ce6a12. Files changed (9): NEW shared/src/narrative.ts (NarrativeLanguage='en'|'ja', DEFAULT_NARRATIVE_LANGUAGE='en', NARRATIVE_MODEL_OPTIONS [nova-micro, nova-lite, nova-pro, claude-haiku], DEFAULT_NARRATIVE_MODEL_ID='us.amazon.nova-lite-v1:0', resolveModelId); shared/src/index.ts re-export; backend/src/bedrock/narrative.ts (per-provider ModelStrategy: anthropicStrategy + amazonNovaStrategy selected via strategyForModel by model id substring 'anthropic.'/'amazon.', default Nova; buildPrompt/fallbackNarrative gained language param with JA prose; generateNarrative gained language param; DEFAULT_MODEL_ID now sourced from shared default); backend/src/handlers/http.ts (parseLanguage normalizes case + region subtag, maps only en/ja else undefined; parseModelId returns trimmed string or undefined, never 400); backend/src/handlers/getPrediction.ts (GET lang/model query params + POST language|lang/model body fields threaded leniently); backend/src/service/bracketService.ts (getPrediction gained language?/model? params, resolves model via resolveModelId, defaults language to DEFAULT_NARRATIVE_LANGUAGE, short-circuits unchanged). Tests: backend narrative.test.ts expanded to 22 tests (EN/JA prompt+fallback, Nova + Anthropic injected-client shaping/parse, resolveModelId allowlist incl. 3 Nova + Claude ids, default = nova-lite); getPrediction.test.ts +3 (lang/model GET+POST accepted, unknown lang/model no 400); bracketService.test.ts +2 (ja + resolved model reach generateNarrative; unknown model falls back to default). Verification: `npm run build` green for shared+backend (and frontend+infra, which consume the additive shared export); `npm test -w @mlb/shared` 14 pass; `npm test -w @mlb/backend` 77 pass. Deviations: existing narrative.test.ts assertions for the old Claude default and Anthropic-only body were deliberately updated to the new Nova default while ADDING Nova coverage (no coverage removed). resolveModelId/allowlist unit assertions live in the backend narrative.test.ts (shared has no colocated test runner wiring for a new file; backend already imports @mlb/shared).
